Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:SR_REP_PRIMARY]

[WAIT] account page rendered and the left rail is visible

[KEY] record the set of script URLs requested so far (BASE_SCRIPTS)

[WAIT] the hub dashboard widgets have rendered

[WAIT] the customers table has at least one row
[KEY] record the URL (URL_CUST), the page H1 text (H1_CUST) and the row count
--- SCREEN: Customer profile ---

[WAIT] customer profile page rendered
[KEY] record the URL (URL_PROFILE) and the page H1 text (H1_PROFILE)
--- SCREEN: Customer orders and one order ---

[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on /graphql for the whole journey
[CONSOLE] no uncaught TypeError or ReferenceError from the hub pages (unrelated image-host DNS errors are excluded)

a hub page after the first renders the host Not Found page or an empty body although the rail still lists it - its route or component did not make the port (mid-journey)
